name: thank-you-next-steps
title: Thank-you next steps
description: The page after a conversion: the confirmation, what happens next in order with timings, a copyable reference, and one or two things to do while waiting.
docs: Pass a title that repeats what was done, a summary with the detail that matters, the steps (a label, an optional detail and when it happens), the follow-up actions and an optional reference such as a booking or order number. The title and summary are announced once when the page loads: a live region that is already full on arrival is not read, so a hidden polite status region is filled after mount. The reference is selectable and has a copy button that confirms in words and says so to a screen reader; if the browser refuses, a line says to copy it by hand and a screen reader hears it too. headingLevel goes from 1 to 4: use 1 when this block is the main content of the thank-you page. Steps are an ordered list joined by a hairline, with the timing as a chip that sits beside the step on a wide section and under it on a narrow one. The check mark is decoration. Name the reference through labels.reference, for example Booking reference or Order number; labels also translates the other fixed words. The block is not ResultState, on purpose: a thank-you page needs a page-level heading, ordered steps with timings and an announcement after mount, where ResultState is a centred panel with one description.
